params.body:
## Why

Second half of the bidding-screen migration (after #264, which took the page heads, the shared bidding form and the 404). This one takes the bids table and the three fragments that `modal.get()` loads: the show-client modal, the agreement modal and the borderel modal. They still carried `card` / `table-responsive` / `table table-hover`, Bootstrap's `custom-switch`, `input-group` and a `row` / `col-3` / `col-6` grid for the borderel checks.

Visual only. `winnerMayBeSet()`, `agreementDocument()` / `borderelDocument()` and everything else in `App\Models\Export\ExportVehicle` are called exactly as before, with the same arguments; `MailRecipient::canSeePurchasePrice()` still drives `$showComments` from the controller, untouched.

This PR is independent of #264: no file overlaps, and it branches off `main`.

## Reachability

| View | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `export/biddingDetails.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@showUser` (`export.show.biedingen` and `export.show.detail`) |
| `export/showUserModal.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@showUserModal` (`export.show.userModal`), opened from the eye button in `export/index.blade.php` |
| `export/showAgreementModal.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@showAgreementModal` (`export.index.agreementModal`), from the print dropdown in `export/index.blade.php` |
| `export/showBorderelModal.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@showBorderelModal` (`export.index.borderelModal`), same dropdown |
| `export/createmodal.blade.php` | used by `ExportController@create` (`export.create.showmodal`); left untouched, it carries no Bootstrap grid or form class any more (its footer button is already `ui-button`) |

Nothing in `resources/views/export/**` came out unreachable, so this PR proposes no deletions. The `export/print/**` tree is out of scope: those are PDF templates with their own stylesheet, not app screens.

## What per view

- **`export/biddingDetails.blade.php`** — `card` / `card-body` / `table-responsive` becomes the same brand card + `overflow-x-auto` wrapper the other two bidding lists already use; `table table-hover` becomes `ui-list`. The three toggles (winner, controlled, delivered) go from `custom-control custom-switch` to the `ui-switch` / `ui-switch-input` / `ui-switch-track` markup, with a `@php` local for the disabled condition so the same expression is not written twice (once for `disabled`, once for the locked look). The print link goes from `btn border btn-info btn-sm` to `ui-action-button`.
- **`export/showUserModal.blade.php`** and **`export/showAgreementModal.blade.php`** — `input-group` / `input-group-prepend` / `input-group-text` becomes `x-ui.affix prefix="€"`, the label plus field becomes `x-ui.field`. `form-control` drops off the number field because `x-ui.number` already merges `ui-input`; `text-right required price_input` stays.
- **`export/showBorderelModal.blade.php`** — same for the takeover price (€) and the mileage (km); the keys and description fields become `x-ui.field` too. The borderel checks lose their `row` / `col-3` / `col-6` grid and become `ui-toggle-list` / `ui-toggle-row`: label left, checkbox right, one row each. `form-control-sm` drops; `option_input` stays on every checkbox.

The Bootstrap modal shell (`modal fade full-modal`, `modal-dialog`, `modal-content`, `modal-header/body/footer`, `.close`) stays on purpose: `resources/js/modal.js` is the controller for these fragments and selects on `.modal` and `.modal-dialog`, and each fragment's own inline script binds `#<id>-modal .close`. Replacing that shell is a separate job from this one.

## JS hooks kept

- `winner_switch` / `gecontroleerd_switch` / `delivered_switch` classes, their `id="..._switch_{{$bid->id}}"`, and `data-bidder` / `data-vehicle`: the inline script in `biddingDetails` binds on the classes, reads the data attributes and `cancelModal(id)` flips the input by id.
- `price_input`, `required`, `text-right`, `option_input` on the fields.
- The form ids `show-user-form`, `show-agreement-form`, `show-borderel-form` and the `custom.opslaan(...)` handlers, plus the `target="_blank"` on the two document forms.
- `data-tip` / `data-tip-pos` and `tooltiptext` on the print link; the `ui.notify` call on a 422 from the winner route is unchanged.

Grepped `resources/js/**` for every id and class first: nothing there refers to `card-body`, `table-responsive`, `custom-control*`, `input-group*` or the `col-*` wrappers in these files.

## Screenshots

1280 and 390, before and after, from the real rendered pages (logged in, a seeded bidding with one bid):
`tw-export-before-details-*` / `tw-export-after-details-*`, and the same pair for `usermodal`, `agreementmodal`, `borderelmodal`.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: green (`public/build` untracked, not committed).
- `phpunit --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|Bidding|Export|ExportDocuments'`: 138 tests, 784 assertions, OK.
params.title: Bidding screens to the ui- vocabulary (2/2): bids table and modals
